leadRow.title: METR found vulnerabilities in historical OpenAI agent monitoring

evidence.sourceTitle: Red-teaming OpenAI’s internal agent monitoring system
evidence.significance: METR reviewed a high-access pilot and historical system state through 21 July, found multiple vulnerabilities and says it did not evaluate the expanded current system. OpenAI says the production safeguards issues were patched. The finding is bounded to that historical scope.

sourceDateVerification.reason: METR primary article displays 22 October 2026 and describes the historical pilot, vulnerabilities, OpenAI patch statement and explicit evaluation limit.

leadRow.title: PRA creates a directorate for operational and cyber resilience
leadRow.source: Primary / Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority / 2026-10-22

evidence.sourceTitle: Mansion House City Regulators Dinner – speech by Katharine Braddick
evidence.organisation: Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority
evidence.significance: The PRA announced a directorate reporting directly to its CEO for operational and cyber resilience, alongside a joint FCA consultation expected by year-end. This is strategic direction and planned consultation, not a current new rule.

sourceDateVerification.reason: PRA primary speech page displays publication date 22 October 2026 and states the new directorate and intended joint FCA consultation.

leadRow.title: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
leadRow.source: Primary / Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority / 2026-10-09

evidence.sourceTitle: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
evidence.organisation: Bank of England and Prudential Regulation Authority
evidence.significance: SIMEX26 involved 38 major banks and market infrastructure operators responding to a global cloud-services disruption scenario. The Bank of England says firms are expected to take action from the exercise. Participation shows rehearsal, not recovery capability; the practical test is whether findings changed service plans, supplier arrangements or response decisions.

leadRow.title: FCA review finds varied conflicts controls in private markets

evidence.sourceTitle: Conflicts of interest and fair customer treatment in private markets
evidence.significance: The FCA reports varied control maturity and calls on firms to review gaps in identifying and managing conflicts. Treat this as supervisory feedback from a multi-firm review, not a new rule.

sourceDateVerification.reason: FCA primary review page displays 23 October 2026 and describes its findings and requested firm action.

leadRow.title: OFSI grants a time-bound licence to wind down Zarubezhneft transactions
leadRow.source: Primary / UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation / 2026-10-08

evidence.organisation: UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation
evidence.significance: OFSI's licence permits defined persons and relevant UK institutions to wind down or divest from transactions involving Zarubezhneft JSC or its subsidiaries. It runs from 8 October to 21 November 2026 and requires complete, readable records for six years. Firms should confirm entity ownership, transaction scope and licence conditions before relying on the permission.

leadRow.title: PHP2Shell advisories warn of critical unauthenticated remote code execution
leadRow.source: Primary / Canadian Centre for Cyber Security / 2026-10-21, updated 2026-10-23

evidence.significance: The advisory describes unauthenticated remote code execution affecting vulnerable PHP installations serving web requests, with internet-facing deployments at heightened risk. Fixed versions are listed. The 23 October update reported no active exploitation at that time and added a separate issue with a temporary mitigation.

sourceDateVerification.reason: Canadian Cyber Centre primary advisory displays 21 October 2026 and shows the 23 October update, affected versions and exploitation status.

leadRow.title: Google Cloud’s London region outage exposes cross-zone recovery limits

evidence.sourceTitle: Google Cloud Service Health incident: europe-west2
evidence.significance: Google’s preliminary report describes a power event in europe-west2-b followed by capacity constraints and impact across the London region. Firms should check whether cross-zone failover and critical-service recovery work under regional control-plane and capacity stress.

sourceDateVerification.reason: Google Cloud Status incident page states the event date as 20 October and describes the europe-west2-b power event and subsequent regional impacts.
